:::{#ppc}

Hello! I am an infectious disease epidemiologist and modeller. My research focuses on developing and applying statistical and mathematical models to understand infectious disease dynamics and inform public health policy. I have worked on malaria, dengue, COVID-19, and diphtheria.

I am currently a Senior Research Fellow at [Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health, National University of Singapore](https://sph.nus.edu.sg/), [MLGH-SG](https://mlgh-sg.com/) group.

:::

## Recent Updates

- **September 2026**: Invited to give a talk on using mathematical models to inform dengue vaccination decisions at [APVRN](https://www.mcri.edu.au/research/projects/apvrn) Masterclass 2026 (Yogyakarta, Indonesia)
- **September 2026**: A milestone for [INDEMIC](https://www.indemic.id/) — we delivered a 5-day workshop on Mathematical Modelling of Infectious Diseases at Monash University Malaysia as part of [SPARKLE](https://sparkle.mccml.my/). Very honoured and thank you SPARKLE for the support!
- **September 2026**: Honoured to be invited to give an [online keynote speech](https://pohalaa.ung.ac.id/symomath/scheduled/2026) at Symposium on Biomathematics (Symomath) 2026, talking about serocatalytic models for infectious disease control in Indonesia. Thank you Indonesia Biomathematics Society (IBMS)!
- **September 2026**: Gave a one-day workshop on Introduction to Infectious Disease Modelling for Public Health Practitioners at the Center for Tropical Medicine, Universitas Gadjah Mada. Very happy to discuss infectious disease modelling with academics and public health practitioners in Yogyakarta!
- **August 2026**: Invited to give a guest lecture on Bayesian Thinking and Analysis for Health Research at Faculty of Medicine, Public Health and Nursing, Universitas Gadjah Mada

*See all updates [here](news.qmd).*

## Research Interests

- Infectious disease epidemiology and modelling
- Statistical and mathematical models for public health
- Real-time outbreak analysis
- Intervention scenarios and evaluations
- Capacity building on infectious disease modelling
